headline: Impex Ferro Tech Limited enters Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process
sum: Impex Ferro Tech Limited has initiated a Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) following an NCLT order, with intimation filed to NSE on 17 June 2026.
detail: On 17 June 2026, Impex Ferro Tech Limited notified the National Stock Exchange of its entry into Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process. The process is administered by an insolvency professional appointed by the National Company Law Tribunal. The company's assets and liabilities are now under moratorium; creditors must file their claims within the statutory period. The resolution process aims to rehabilitate the company or recommend liquidation within 180 days (extendable by 90 days).
